verdict.rationale: Open-source availability is a fair question for a data-integration platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence describes Fivetran as a fully managed SaaS and never documents its core source being published under an open license. The Connector SDK repo and the fivetran-mcp GitHub repo are adjacent tooling with no license stated, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
